hooks.text: 同一委托由不同英雄执行时，会拥有专属对话、神祇关系和麻烦，从而生成完全不同的故事
hooks.excerpt: Every hero experiences each assignment in their own way — with their own dialogues, their own gods, and their own troubles. One quest, a dozen heroes — a dozen different ways to complicate everything. Play the same quest with different heroes and get completely different stories.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 奥林匹斯诸神会亲自干预战斗、赐福或诅咒，甚至同时施加两者，玩家行动决定最终阵营与援军
hooks.excerpt: The gods are not merely a source of assignments: they intervene in battle, grant blessings and impose curses — sometimes simultaneously, and always for very personal reasons. Only your actions will determine which side you end up on and who will come to your aid in the decisive hour.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每项委托都有独立故事与目标，涵盖Boss战、送货和资源收集，通关剧情后再开放无限竞技场
hooks.excerpt: Forget "survive for N minutes" — every assignment here has its own story. Dozens of unique story-driven quests with different types of tasks: battles with bosses, delivery, resource gathering, and much more. A variety of heroes, diverse weapons, powerful amulets and Divine Gifts. Hone your skills in the endless arena mode once the story is complete.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 失败后缺少可延续的英雄或武器成长
